Name: Akuma No Mi
Author: RazielMagwi
Description:
[center][/center][center]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/C1GqzQL/Akuma-No-Mi-7-3-2024.png[/img]﻿[/center][font=Georgia]
[center][size=3]Welcome to Akuma No Mi, a mod aimed at expanding the content of Stardew Valley![/size]

[b][u][size=6]About Akuma No Mi[/size][/u][/b][/center]
[/font][center][size=3]﻿Stardew Valley is full of inspiring moments that draw you into its world and with Akuma No Mi (ANM) I hope to create more of those moments, so you can always find something new when you return to the valley.

In ANM I try to stay as true to vanilla as possible, adding content from the popular One Piece anime, geared towards the end game. You will be able to start enjoying it from an already started game or a new one, once Willy's old ship is running and you visit for the first time the ginger island.[/size][/center][font=Georgia]
[/font][font=Georgia][center]
[u][b][size=6]Features[/size][/b][/u]

[size=3][/size][/center][center][size=3]2 New machines. Cola dispenser and create perfume.

The new machine for making perfumes from flowers is currently only compatible with: Vanilla, SVE, RSV, ES, LVMV
But soon I will have ready the perfumes of:
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford[/url]﻿
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna[/url]﻿
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿﻿
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]

11 New fruit trees with their respective devil fruit.
4 New enemies with drop unique.
New furniture for your farm.
5 New powerful weapons.
1 New animal for coop.
6 New fishes.
4 New foods.
[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=3]One new event with Leo.
New Special Orders.
2 New shops.
And much more...[/size][/center][center]﻿[/center][center]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Wkv1PKb/Captura-de-pantalla-2024-05-20-020527.png[/img]


[u][b][size=6]Coming Soon[/size][/b][/u]

[size=3] - Nami as NPC
 - New flowers and perfumes.
 - More quests and events.[/size]


[u][b][size=6]Install[/size][/b][/u]
[font=Georgia]
Since 2.0.3v only the official one will be found, which is programmed to identify whether or not you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ mod.
In case you have it, the weapons and enemies will be stronger.

[b]I do NOT recommend to overwrite if you already had the mod installed.
[/b]
[/font][size=4]Steps:[/size]
[size=3]Download and install all required mods.[/size]
[size=3]﻿- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][size=3]﻿- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager
[/url][size=3]﻿- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod
[/url][size=3]﻿- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework
[/url][size=3]﻿- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore
[/url][size=3]- Download and install Akuma No Mi mod.[/size]
[size=3]- Have fun![/size]

[u][b][size=6]FAQ[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[center][size=3]> Is this compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside, East scarp? <
[/size][size=3]Yes, yes it is.

> Do I need to start a new game to play this mod? <
[/size][size=3]No, this mod is safe to install in an existing save.

[/size][size=3]> Is the content adapted to the manga? <
No, it is not adapted to anime or manga. It is only One Piece themed content. Mention is made to some characters and in the future when I place npc their phrases will allude to their adventures but I will not go into great themes or delve into the lore, because I am not an expert. [/size][/center]
[b][u][size=6][center]Permits[/center][/size][/u][/b]
[center]PLEASE DO NOT REDISTRIBUTE ANY FILES OF THIS MOD.
You can recolor, edit or use AI in the mod art and change the designs, however when posting it I only ask that you mention the main Mod.
You can make a translation, the mod uses the i18n system for ease of use. Feel free to post it on the forum or upload it as your own mod, but remember to mention the ANM mod as the main mod.[/center]


Note: I want to clarify that I am not an expert in making mods, nor in drawing pixels, much less in the world of One Piece. I started this mod to bring more content to my wife's games, learn a little more about mods and include content focused on the popular anime One Piece. So, not all content will be faithfully adapted, even some things may be far from the famous pirates. But I hope you can still enjoy them as much as I did making them.

[/font][center][b][font=Georgia][size=4]Creator: [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/20086359][size=4]RazielMagwi[/size][/url][/font][/b][/center]
